TZA.note: Names a data sharing API but does not say it authenticates identity.

facts.fact: NIDA says the Jamii Number is issued once in a lifetime and deactivated at death, with a CRVS-ID data sharing API fully operational.
NIDA says the NIDA-RITA merger announced in 2023 is to be completed from 2026.
The deck gives Tanzania's population as 61.7 million from the 2022 census.
NIDA says eRITA issues a birth certificate in 48 hours, with online applications and digitized records, and 9.4 million under-5s registered.

TZA.note: Says only that data protection laws came after the systems; no law is named.
The 87% (27.1 million) is of adults 18 and over, not the whole population.

facts.fact: NIDA says the national ID is issued only from age 18, leaving children without an identity number for nearly two decades.

TZA.note: Nothing stated on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
Names services drawing on the ID API but no public register keyed on the number.

facts.fact: NIDA says it issues national IDs to citizens, legal residents and refugees, with the NIN issued within 72 hours and 27.1 million adults covered.

TZA.note: Gives 70.2% internet penetration without saying it is a share of people who use the internet.
Gives 113% mobile penetration, a subscription count.
Lists refugees among those NIDA issues IDs to, with no number stated.
Does not say births or deaths are entered digitally at the local registration office.
